title: feat(2d): import SVG drawings as 2D sketch profiles
body:
## What changed

The SVG reader, `camcraft_geometry::svg`, reads drawings into the DXF `Document` type. It shares sketch chaining, nesting, `SketchData`, sketch entities, and project storage with DXF import.

- Read paths, lines, polylines, polygons, rectangles, circles, and ellipses.
- Apply group transforms and references to elements in the same file.
- Keep circular arcs analytic. Flatten Beziers and other ellipses within 0.005 mm.
- Read mm, cm, in, pt, pc, and px sizes, `viewBox`, and `preserveAspectRatio`.
- Reflect Y about the page height. Use top-level group labels or IDs as layers.
- Count unsupported content, hidden content, markers and paint-only stylesheets as skipped. This includes stylesheets inside `<defs>`.
- Add the undoable `ImportSvg` command, the `import_svg` MCP tool, and the `cam.importSvg` script verb.
- Update the user guide and MCP reference. Record decisions in `docs/decisions/1880-svg-import.md`.

## Refusals

The reader names malformed input, unsupported units, invalid sizes, singular transforms, and exceeded import limits. A file without physical units needs the caller's unit. A sized file refuses a caller unit.

The reader also refuses root `<svg>` transform attributes, and `transform-origin` and `transform-box` presentation attributes.

The reader finds a duplicate attribute name with a map. The scan that it replaces was quadratic in the attribute count of one tag.

The reader reads an inline `style` against an allow-list of the properties that cannot change geometry (`SAFE_PROPERTIES` in `svg/facts.rs`). The reader refuses each other property by name. The reader reads the style and the transform of an element one time, finds a `use` target in a map of the ids, and charges the shape data of each visit against a work budget.

The latest review fix (the delta safety read on `eaafd2e72`) closes the class "an input changes or hides a shape, and the import ignores it":

- A `<style>` sheet is checked with the same allow-list, with no selector matching (`svg/sheet.rs`). The reader refuses `display`, `visibility` and each property that is not on the list. A paint-only sheet imports.
- The reader refuses an `<?xml-stylesheet?>` instruction and a `<link rel="stylesheet">` by name.
- The reader refuses `animate`, `set`, `animateTransform`, `animateMotion`, `animateColor` and `discard` at each place in the tree.
- A child of a shape or of a `use` that is not `title`, `desc`, `metadata` or `style` is counted as `<child> in <parent>`.
- The reader refuses a reference to a DOCTYPE entity in content and in an attribute value. A namespace declaration is the exception.
- The reader refuses a `preserveAspectRatio` value that is not in the SVG grammar.
- A marker property that draws a marker is counted as `marker`.
- The user guide says that a shape with a stroke imports as its centre line.

## Validation on the final head

Head: `f96ea8fa0729e6432459182e45a60b7c4a096772`. It is a merge of `upstream/main` `d54580caddb37ab2a63044507577c506514ffa64` into the reviewed code head `671426992`.
The gates ran on this head with `--base upstream/main` at `d54580cad`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | PASS: 1,186 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 18.1 minutes |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | PASS: 95 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 24.0 minutes |
| `clippy -D warnings` | PASS: a step of the quick gate |
| `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work` | PASS in the quick gate |
| `app suites: first_router_part`, `mcp_svg` | PASS in the quick gate |
| geometry `svg`, `svg_refusals`, `svg_style_safety`, `svg_tree_rules`, `svg_visibility` | 16 / 19 / 6 / 9 / 11 passed |

**Merge of main.** The merge had one conflict, in `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` (a generated file: the tool count).
I wrote the file again with `cargo run -p camcraft-app --bin camcraft-cli -- mcp reference`. It differs from the file of main only in the count (121 tools) and the `import_svg` row.
The merge has no other hand edit. No source file had a conflict.
Main moved to `37aca7f8c` (#3620, the verifier island slices in `sim`) during the heavy run. `git merge-tree` of this head with that main is clean. The gates did not run against that main.
The heavy plan has 95 steps on this base. It had 255 steps on the base `2de071415`. I did not examine the cause of the difference.

Pin proof (`crates/geometry/tests/svg_tree_rules.rs`, 9 tests). For each row, the mutation was made, the binary ran, and the code was restored. With the code restored, all 9 tests pass in 0.2 s.

| Mutation | Red pin |
|---|---|
| The sheet is not checked | `svg_style_sheet_rules_that_hide_or_resize_a_shape_are_refused_by_name` |
| `display` and `visibility` in a sheet are accepted | the same test |
| A `;` outside a rule is skipped | the same test |
| A rule inside a rule is not refused | the same test |
| The text of a CDATA section in `<style>` is dropped | the same test |
| An `xml-stylesheet` instruction is skipped | `svg_external_style_sheets_are_refused_by_name` |
| A `<link rel="stylesheet">` is not refused | the same test |
| The animation list is not used | `svg_animation_elements_are_refused_by_name_at_each_place` |
| The children of a shape are not counted | `svg_elements_below_a_shape_or_a_use_are_counted_by_name` |
| The scan of the children charges no work | `svg_children_of_a_reused_shape_are_charged_against_the_work_budget` |
| The entity check is off | `svg_doctype_entity_references_are_refused_by_name` |
| An unknown alignment is xMin/yMin | `svg_preserve_aspect_ratio_places_the_view_box_and_refuses_an_unknown_value` |
| An unknown meet-or-slice word is `meet` | the same test |
| A marker attribute or inline declaration is not counted | `svg_marker_shapes_are_counted_as_skipped` |
| A marker in a sheet is not counted | `svg_paint_only_style_sheets_import_at_the_attribute_size` |

`svg_paint_only_style_sheets_import_at_the_attribute_size` pins that a usual paint sheet (`.cls-1{fill:none;stroke:#000}`, `@font-face`, `@charset`) still imports.
One existing test changed: `svg_stylesheets_inside_defs_and_tree_are_counted_as_skipped` had the sheet `.h{display:none}`. The reader now refuses that sheet, so the test uses a paint rule.

The pins of the earlier rounds are in `svg_style_safety.rs`, `svg_refusals.rs` and `svg_visibility.rs`. They passed in the quick gate.

## Goldens moved

None. The catalog suites ran and passed on the final head. The diff against `upstream/main` changes no recorded program, golden or snapshot PNG.

## Not exercised

- A posted G-code golden for an SVG profile remains in follow-up #3042. This fix round did not exercise it.
- The `import_svg` row in `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` remains outside this fix round.
- Nested SVG viewports, selector matching of a style sheet, text to outlines, and embedded images remain outside this reader's scope.
- The merge with main `37aca7f8c` is not built and not gated. The gated base is `d54580cad`.
- The mutations of the pin table were not run again on the merge head. The merge changes no SVG source file and no SVG test.
- The description of the `import_svg` MCP tool is not changed.
- The four follow-ups of the first review on `eaafd2e72` (Inkscape long style, `vector-effect` attribute, the 5 s time limits, the skill row) are not changed.

No UI source changed. Before/after screenshots do not apply.

Changelog: Import SVG drawings (paths, shapes, group transforms, mm/cm/in/pt/pc/px sizes) as 2D profiles on the stock, with the `import_svg` MCP tool and `cam.importSvg`; an SVG with no physical size is refused until you state its unit.

Effort: high

Fixes #1880
